reporting-org.narrative:
Reference Number: NIHR200817 Research Title ENHANCE: Scaling-up Care for Perinatal Depression through Technological Enhancements to the ‘Thinking Healthy Programme’
ENHANCE project is a regional collaboration funded by the National Institute for Health Research (NIHR), UK to reduce the treatment gap for perinatal depression in Pakistan, the South Asian region and other low resource settings globally. ENHANCE aims to reduce treatment gap for perinatal depression by:
- Developing a digital Application (App) to facilitate delivery of a World Health Organization (WHO) approved the Thinking Healthy Programme for perinatal depression and its evaluation in low resource community settings of Pakistan and translating research outputs for Nepal, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.
- Developing a collaborative network of institutions and researchers from Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka engaged in implementing perinatal mental health with a focus upon THP.
- Building the capacity of the network to undertake research in areas which are critical for implementation of interventions for perinatal mental health.
